analysis:
Reviewed EngineV2Bridge.swift (patch + base/head text) and MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift (patch plus a metadata-only unit 8ba6b50ddca62d55:0). Changes:
1. EngineV2Bridge: renames mimoCalibration (MimoCalibrationState) to modelCalibration (ModelCalibrationState) and adds an injectable calibrationPosturePermitsWork closure. Its default allows work only when Low Power Mode is off and thermalState is .nominal. It is stored at head line 301 and assigned in init at line 388. This is a local availability and posture gate; it only restricts calibration work and does not touch crypto, key, attestation or prefix-cache surfaces. It is a plain closure and does not take or log request content.
2. MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine: adds the immutable measurementPurpose: EngineMeasurementPurpose, defaulting to .serving in both initializers, and threads it into the request submission paths at patch lines 685, 905 and 1019. Not visible in the supplied units: EngineMeasurementPurpose semantics, the downstream ModelCalibrationState, the consumers of calibrationPosturePermitsWork, and how a non-serving purpose affects cache donation (cacheEnabled:false already appears at the native path), usage and billing signals, telemetry, and coordinator-visible state. The next pass should confirm that measurement or calibration requests (a) never donate to or read from the SSD prefix cache (T-041, SEC-035), (b) never carry consumer plaintext, (c) cannot be triggered by remote input, and (d) do not distort the throughput or capacity telemetry the coordinator trusts (TB-002, T-007). No concrete security regression is visible in the supplied hunks; the default retains serving behavior. Coverage limit: callers and the downstream calibration implementation were not supplied.
